turns.text: How do I participate in ABDM Sandbox?

must_contain: you register your application on the ABDM sandbox portal
registering gives you a client id and a client secret
you must register before you can start integrating your solution
notes: NHA's whole answer here is 'Please apply at sanbox.ndhm.gov.in'; the facts in must_contain come from the catalogue's registration atom, not from NHA's own answer.
